pages.text: $(italic)A mythical beast of impossible speed. The fastest race in the game.$()$(br2)$(bold)Unrivaled Speed$(): two and a half times the base walking speed, always, and Speed II for 12s on demand (60s cooldown).$(br2)$(bold)Pounce$(): launch forward (25s cooldown).

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Wall Climbing$(): climb vertical surfaces like a spider.$(br2)$(bold)Cat Vision$(): see clearly in the dark.$(br2)$(bold)Fall Immunity$(): no fall damage.$(br2)$(bold)Sprint Jump$(): a stronger jump while sprinting.$(br2)$(bold)Fragile$(): $(warn)-10% max HP$() (one heart less).

pages.title: Tradeoffs
pages.text: $(bold)Exhaustion$(): $(warn)constant movement burns food faster.$()$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with Wanderer or Ranger and never stand still. Stillness is the only way you die.$()
